text: Then the other man—this man, if this is he—must pay it for you.” Sergeant is sorry to add that the other man is not prepared with the money either. “Very well! Then you must pay it between you or you must both be sued for it and both suffer. You have had the money and must refund it. You are not to pocket other people’s pounds, shillings, and pence and escape scot-free.” The lawyer sits down in his easy-chair and stirs the fire.
